Variants.Content: Entry The Andals crossed into Westeros from across the Narrow Sea, bringing with them iron weapons, knightly traditions, the Faith of the Seven Gods, and new noble families. They first established themselves in the valley, and then spread to the southern lands; the North and the Iron Islands retained more of the traditions of their ancestors due to geography and force. install The southern knights regard the Andal blood as the glory of the legal system, while the believers of the Old God remember the felled heart tree. Many of the cultural cracks in the Seven Kingdoms began with this crossing of the sea.
